about.label: 01 — About
about.heading:
Designing with
purpose & passion
paragraphs: I'm Denise, a fresh Digital Design & Arts graduate with a deep love for design that connects, communicates, and delights. I specialize in UI/UX design, brand identity, and digital illustration — weaving storytelling into every piece of work I create.
Currently available for freelance projects. Whether it's a mobile app, a brand refresh, or a creative campaign, I bring curiosity, care, and craft to every collaboration.

items.title: UI/UX Design
items.desc: Crafting intuitive interfaces and seamless user journeys. From wireframes and prototypes to polished, pixel-perfect designs using Figma.

items.title: Graphic Design
items.desc: Creating visual identities, print materials, social media content, and brand collateral that leaves lasting impressions through thoughtful composition.

items.title: Digital Design & Arts
items.desc: Bringing stories to life through video editing, audio production, and digital illustration — blending art and technology with a cinematic eye.
